provenance.execution: Combines 1787 historical rows, including all 1662 previously correct answers, with two targeted reruns. Previously correct samples were not rerun under updated semantics.
provenance.calibration: Reference-assisted, in-sample semantic calibration; no held-out evaluation. Inferred default field mappings do not independently resolve question ambiguity. Source values, reference answers and scorer are unchanged.
provenance.statistics: Mixed historical and fresh row costs, not a fresh complete-run cost; excludes superseded attempts and retry overhead.
